Backup & Restore
Local Storage
Data is autosaved to your browser. Download a backup regularly — clearing browser cache or switching devices will lose data without a backup file.
☁ Cloud Sync (Firebase)
When signed in, the app pushes a backup to Firebase every 2 minutes (and when you click Sync Now). Photos go to Firebase Storage. Only emails in the whitelist can sign in. To configure Firebase, see README.md at the repo.
🔬 System Health & Diagnostics
Runs a battery of 18+ tests covering localStorage, Firebase sync, write/read roundtrips, code coverage of mutations, and local-cloud divergence. Non-destructive — touches no warehouse data.
Run this after every deploy, when something feels off, or weekly as a routine health check. The sync badge in the top-right shows live status; this panel gives you the full breakdown.

🔑 Admin Tools
Restricted actions — admin role only
After deploying a new version, click this to notify all other devices. They'll show an "Update available" banner and reload to the latest code.
Sync runs automatically in background — checks every 10s, heartbeat pull every 30s, auto-fixes silently. Use this button only if you want to see real-time stats or run a manual test.
Deletes all units, factory items, marriages, dispatched, cover stock, materials, requests, incoming. Keeps color/model library + settings + authorized users. Auto-downloads a backup JSON first.
